让你的 agent 直接使用 Margin: Let your agent work directly in Margin
连接后，agent 可查看照片信息与预览，调整边框和水印，并在本机导出照片。: Connected agents can view photo information and previews, adjust frames and watermarks, and export photos locally.
在 agent 的 MCP 设置中添加下方配置，随后刷新连接。使用时保持 Mar: Add this configuration to your agent’s MCP settings, then refresh the connection. Keep Margin open while using it.
已选中配置，请按 ⌘C / Ctrl+C 复制: Configuration selected. Press ⌘C / Ctrl+C to copy.
照片选择、导入与批量导出: Photo selection, import and batch export
实际加框预览与导出进度: Actual framed previews and export progress
目录移除及最近 20 次撤销／重做，原图保留: Catalog removal and 20 persistent undo/redo operations; originals are kept
操作由连接的 agent 发起，Margin 在本机处理照片。模型登录资料独立保: Your connected agent requests operations; Margin processes photos locally. Model sign-in information is stored separately.
关闭连接后停止接收新指令；已开始的导出可在主界面取消。: Disabling stops new commands. Exports already started can be cancelled in the main window.
无需额外安装 Node 或 Pi: No Node or Pi installation required
操作尚未完成，请查看主界面进度后重试: The operation is still running. Check its progress in the main window before retrying.
照片窗口尚未就绪，请稍后重试: The photo window is not ready. Try again shortly.
请等待当前操作完成后再使用 Agent: Wait for the current operation before using the agent.
请先完成或关闭当前对话框: Finish or close the current dialog first.
模板已变化，请重新读取模板列表: The templates changed. Refresh the template list.
请等待当前导出完成: Wait for the current export to finish.
导入正在排队，请稍后查看照片列表: The import is queued. Check the photo list shortly.
预览暂不可用: The preview is not available yet.
请先选择要移除的照片: Select the photos to remove first.
没有可撤销的移除记录: There is no catalog removal to undo.
没有可重做的移除记录: There is no catalog removal to redo.
